info.title: ChatHome GPT Read Actions
info.summary: Anonymous, read-only access to Grande Région property search and Luxembourg market data.
info.description: Anonymous property search and source-backed Luxembourg market data. No inquiries, document uploads, account data or general MCP execution.

tags.name: Market data
tags.description: Luxembourg commune and national market intelligence.

post.summary: Search properties for rent or for sale
post.description: Natural-language (vibe) or structured (classic) property search across supported Grande Région inventory. Vibe mode uses an LLM plan plus embeddings and is rate limited more tightly than classic mode. Send the searcher's own words; the engine handles vague and partial queries.

mode.description: "vibe" is natural-language search (LLM plan + embeddings). "classic" is structured filtering with no model call.

query.description: The searcher's own words, for example: quiet 2-bed near Kirchberg with a balcony under 2000. Required for vibe mode; longer text is truncated at 800 characters.

intent.description: Whether to search rentals or properties for sale.

limit.description: Results to return. Anonymous callers are capped at 120 (200 for map requests).

includeCrossBorder.description: The Grande Région is the default market. Send false to restrict to Luxembourg.

filters.description: Structured filters for classic mode (location, price bounds, bedrooms, property type). Unknown keys are reported back in `ignoredFilters` rather than rejected.

value.query: quiet 2-bedroom apartment near Kirchberg with a balcony under 2500

schema.description: Search outcome. The engine returns additional diagnostic fields (run report, per-result criterion checks, match summary) not described here.

status.description: "ok" means results were served. "needs_refinement" and "needs_clarification" mean the request could not be compiled into a search the engine can prove, and NO listings are returned — an empty list in that state is not a claim that the market is empty.

items.description: A property result. More fields are returned than are listed here; treat the object as open.

description.description: Short snippet of the agency's own copy.

price.description: Preformatted whole-euro display string, e.g. "EUR 1,850". Never cents.

priceAmount.description: Asking amount in whole euros, or null for price-on-request. Prefer this over parsing `price`.

matchScore.description: Relevance 0-100 for vibe searches, or null when there is no query-relevant signal to score.

explanation.description: Why this listing matched, when the engine can say.

brief.description: Vibe mode: the typed reading of the request the search ran on — places, commutes, needs bound to listing facts, and `unmapped` wishes that were not checked. Send it back as `brief` to re-run it without a new reading.

coverageNotice.description: What the search could NOT cover, when applicable.

ignoredFilters.description: Filters we could not honour, named rather than swallowed.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry later or authenticate.

get.description: Source-checked public facts for a single property, with gallery photos and the canonical chathome.lu URL. Facts without source evidence are returned as unknown rather than guessed.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Translate the listing copy into this language.

schema.description: Listing document: identity, price, specs, location, images, agency contact target, and per-fact source evidence.
Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.

get.description: Every Luxembourg commune with slug, localized name, and liveability score. Cached one hour.

liveabilityAvailability.description: Present when the static commune registry is returned because live intelligence is unavailable; all liveability scores then stay null.

schema.description: Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.

get.summary: Get market context and liveability for a commune
get.description: Market data and liveability dimensions for one commune — prices, transport, schools, amenities — with the sources each dimension rests on and when it was last updated. Same capability as the get_market_context MCP tool.

schema.description: Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.
Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.

get.summary: Get the latest published Luxembourg Price Index issue
get.description: The most recent published issue of the Luxembourg Price Index. Methodology is documented at /en/prices/methodology.

schema.description: Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.

get.summary: Get official national housing and energy indicators
get.description: Housing-price and energy-price indicators published by the national statistical authority of France, Germany, or Belgium, and the Eurostat national house-price index for Luxembourg. Luxembourg has a housing indicator only: its energy field is always null.

schema.description: Standard public-API error envelope used by /api/public/v1 routes.
